Author: jFray
Name: EchoMix
Description: An interactive DJ deck with live mixing tools, custom playlists, and a synced listener mode with an audio visualizer.
Punchline: Spin tracks and let the party sync in.
Changelog:
Added Spotify Mode remote controls to the minimized window: right-click to skip, Shift+right-click to go back, Shift+click to play/pause
Added a Listeners section to the Host Lobby, showing everyone currently tuned in
Fixed a rare issue where Spotify Mode's audio quality could degrade and stay that way until a plugin restart
